topic: 45° Scan Range and Link Budget Calculations
consensus_response: The 45° scan range significantly impacts link budget calculations for edge-of-coverage (EO) users by introducing complexities in link budget modeling. This includes detailed modeling of path loss, interference patterns, and beam squinting. The increased complexity can be addressed through specialized software tools and algorithms designed to handle the increased complexity. Advanced techniques like AI/ML can automate the process of link budget calculations and create adaptive beamforming techniques to dynamically adjust the beam patterns based on real-time environmental conditions. Future trends like Massive MIMO and THz communication can further optimize performance.
